_meta.licence: Open Government Licence – Canada (https://open.canada.ca/en/open-government-licence-canada). Elections Canada publishes its official voting results datasets under this licence on open.canada.ca.
_meta.notes: District numbers are the 2023 Representation Order numbers. They were checked against Elections Canada's 2023 boundary file and their first two digits against Statistics Canada's province codes (PRUID). Statistics Canada's FED 2023 FEDUIDs use the same five-digit numbers. Names are Elections Canada's official English and French names (em dashes restored). totalVotes is all ballots cast, including rejected ballots; turnout is totalVotes ÷ electors. Candidate share is Elections Canada's percentage of valid votes.

boundaries.source: Elections Canada, Federal Electoral District boundaries (2023)

_meta.renamed: Names are as at the election. Where Parliament has since renamed a district, currentName holds the name in Elections Canada's current boundary file.
